title: Transmission Assay for Cicadella Viridis
author: Niels Appelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jghujw
materials: Capture the insects required in the experiment.
Mark this side of the container as “clean”.
Swiftly close the container with the screw cap

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Create an overnight (o/n) culture of the bacteria intended for transmission testing.

steps.title: Sterilize Equipment
steps.instruction: UV sterilize the following items: one PCR tube tray, 2 x N PCR tubes, 2 x N pieces of 1 * 16 cm green tape, 2 x N pieces of 1 * 2 cm parafilm M, and M9TG medium (where N is the number of replicates including negative control). Alcohol-sterilize a pair of scissors.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Tubes
steps.instruction: Modify the PCR tubes by cutting and removing caps.

substeps.instruction: Cut the last 2 PCR tubes from all rows of 8
Cut off the caps from the remaining 6 tubes

steps.title: Prepare Control PCR Tube Lines
steps.instruction: Fill N/2 lines of 6 tubes with 320 uL M9TG medium per tube, ensuring no bubbles form at the bottom when using 1250 uL pipette tips.

substeps.instruction: Stretch parafilm M over the far ends of the line of PCR tubes so it contacts the solution
Stretch parafilm M over the sides of the line of PCR tubes, ensuring no air bubbles form
Apply green tape around the line of tubes to secure the parafilm M

steps.title: Prepare Insect Containers
steps.instruction: Prepare N 250 mL PET containers (flesschenland.com) for the insects.

substeps.instruction: Use an injection needle to make airholes in the screw cap
Wetten a single-use paper towel with tapwater, squeeze out excess water, and cover the floor of the container

steps.title: Install Control Tubes
steps.instruction: Attach the lines of M9TG PCR tubes to one side of the containers using short stretches (+/- 1 cm) of green tape (tweezers may be used).

steps.title: Prepare Experimental PCR Tube Lines
steps.instruction: Create experimental tube lines by filling N/2 lines of 6 tubes with 320 uL of a solution consisting of 80% M9TG and 20% o/n culture.

substeps.instruction: Stretch parafilm M over the far ends of the line of PCR tubes so it contacts the solution
Stretch parafilm M over the sides of the line of PCR tubes, ensuring no air bubbles form
Apply green tape around the line of tubes to secure the parafilm M

steps.title: Install Experimental Tubes
steps.instruction: Attach the experimental PCR tube lines to the wall of the container opposite to the clean line using short stretches (+/- 1 cm) of green tape. Label this side with the bacterium identifier.

steps.title: Introduce Insects to Containers
steps.instruction: Transfer insects from a collection bottle into the PET containers.

substeps.instruction: Move insects to the bottom of the collection bottle by inverting it and waiting for them to climb up, or by gently tapping
Open the PET container and invert the collection bottle above it
Unscrew the bottle cap and dislodge insects with a few forceful taps (tap the sides of the container with the bottle to prevent insects from jumping out)

steps.title: Incubate Insects
steps.instruction: Keep the containers at room temperature, protected from direct sunlight.

steps.title: Harvest Insects
steps.instruction: Sedate or kill the insects by injecting a sedative (e.g., ethyl acetate or chloroform) through the screwcap.

steps.title: Dissect Insect Heads
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes containing 200 uL of LB medium for each insect used.

substeps.instruction: Use a scalpel to dissect the head of the insect by cutting through the thorax
Place the dissected heads into the eppendorf tubes
Crush the heads using the backside of an inoculation loop (avoid touching the backside of the loop to prevent contamination)

steps.title: Plate Samples
steps.instruction: Process the samples for bacterial growth.

substeps.instruction: Briefly vortex the eppendorf tubes and plate 100 uL on an agar plate with antibiotics suitable for the bacterium's resistance
Plate 100 uL from the 'clean' PCR tubes (and optionally some spiked PCR tubes as a control)
Note: Samples from the same container or insects of the same sex/container may be pooled to reduce the number of plates

steps.title: Incubate and Analyze
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates overnight at 37 C.

substeps.instruction: Count the resulting colonies on plates for insects and PCR tubes
Verify colony identity via colony PCR
